description:
Upload an image, video (mp4/webm), audio (mp3/wav/m4a/aac), 3D mesh (glb, gltf, fbx, obj, stl), or a document for Gemini chat, presentations, or document jobs, up to 10 MiB, as base64.

Returns key and url; either can be used as a media or 3D mesh reference (for example Higgsfield
image_urls, video_urls, audio_urls, Gemini chat video_url/input_audio/image_url, or 3D post-processing
model_url in estimate_3d_process / create_3d_process). The file type is checked by content, not by the header.

Documents: chat:write or uploads:write accepts PDF, DOCX, DOC, DOTX, ODT, PPTX, PPT, ODP, XLSX, XLS, ODS, TXT,
MD, and CSV for Gemini chat_completion file_url parts (up to 10 MiB in MCP, 50 MiB via HTTP multipart).
presentations:write / documents:write accepts PPTX, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, TXT, MD, CSV for file_urls of
create_presentation, revise_presentation, create_document and revise_document. The answer also has filename
(ASCII-normalized; name files in Latin letters when the name matters).
name: upload_media
